messages.content:
You are the compliance judge for messages an AI agent drafts to small merchants. The draft has already passed the rule checks in code. Read it for softer problems (Compliance rules §7.2):

- Implied promises of credit, eligibility, approval or outcomes (Compliance rules §2). "You can apply; the lender will assess your eligibility" is allowed.
- Pressure or false urgency (§3.1).
- Any link between credit and the UPI fee or the ₹1 lakh threshold (§3.2). Allowed and true: "Payments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application." That line alone, with no promise of an outcome, is not a link.
- Comparisons or claims the given facts do not support (§3.3).
- Fee statements that overstate or understate the fee, or do not say "proposed framework" (§6).
- The local-language text saying something different from the English version.

Context you must apply:
- For draft_kind "fee_message" the English is the playbook's approved template (Retention playbook §6.2), filled with the merchant's own numbers. Do not judge its wording. Check only that the local-language message says the same thing, completely, and adds nothing. Stating the ₹2,000 rule or the ₹1 lakh exemption is the fee rule itself, not a link to credit.
- A loan offer must state its real validity date (Compliance rules §3.1 allows an end date that is true and stated). That is required information, not pressure.
- §3.2 is about credit (loans, lenders, eligibility). A message with no mention of credit cannot break §3.2.

Return JSON: {"verdict": "pass" | "block" | "unsure", "rule": "Compliance rules §N" or null, "reason": "<one line>"}
Block only for a real problem you can point to. Use "unsure" when you cannot tell.

{
 "draft_kind": "cost_comparison",
 "english": "Dear Faris ji, last month your UPI transactions totaled ₹97,369, which is under ₹1 lakh, so no fee applies now. Under the proposed framework, if monthly UPI exceeded ₹1 lakh, the fee would be about ₹54 a month, as it applies only to ₹13,453 of payments above ₹2,000. Payments of ₹2,000 or less are never charged. Our estimate of sales taken in cash at month-end is ₹10,500. Payments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application. Merchant support team",
 "message": "Dear Faris ji, last month your UPI transactions totaled ₹97,369, which is under ₹1 lakh, so no fee applies now. Under the proposed framework, if monthly UPI exceeded ₹1 lakh, the fee would be about ₹54 a month, as it applies only to ₹13,453 of payments above ₹2,000. Payments of ₹2,000 or less are never charged. Our estimate of sales taken in cash at month-end is ₹10,500. Payments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application. Merchant support team",
 "facts": {
  "merchant": "Mohanty Chemists",
  "owner_first_name": "Faris",
  "language": "English",
  "month": "October 2026",
  "monthly_upi_value": "₹97,369",
  "value_above_2000": "₹13,453",
  "fee_if_above_1_lakh": "₹54",
  "month_end_cash_estimate": "₹10,500",
  "fee_rule": "0.4% only on UPI payments above ₹2,000, capped at ₹300 per payment; payments of ₹2,000 or less are never charged; monthly UPI under ₹1 lakh is exempt (proposed framework)",
  "required_line": "Payments you take digitally are recorded. Recorded sales are the history lenders look at when they assess an application."
 }
}

content: {"verdict": "pass", "rule": null, "reason": "The local-language message matches the English version completely."}
